headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when Bryan Danielson vs. Chris Jericho met in a Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.29 ? a fantastic contest. Jericho targeted Danielson's freshly injured ankle with a ring-post assault, but Danielson fought back and locked in the LeBell Lock to force the tap ? the first time he'd ever beaten Jericho.

That Wednesday in 2022, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Swerve in our Glory vs. The Lucha Brothers went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.13 ? a well-worked match. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

2022 brought us this moment: Samoa Joe vs. Josh Woods went to battle over the ROH World TV Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.24. It was the first title opportunity of Josh Woods's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
